sources.dependency_boundary: Theorem 1.9's branching proof uses earlier Sturm root-counting results; that entire dependency chain and the full book were not independently re-proved or declared audited. Projection/quantifier elimination is used as an established theorem. No external reach theorem is imported.
sources.application: The admissible weighted tube radius and the finite algebraic coefficient suprema are semialgebraic; one-variable growth controls their dependence on the flux trim. Arclength, source profiles, exponential modes and normalization integrals are not asserted semialgebraic.
sources.access_notes: Original author URL failed certificate verification in embedded Python and returned 403 with normal PowerShell TLS; a guessed replacement and another academic mirror returned 404. The UCM academic mirror downloaded with normal TLS verification. A later web-tool open timed out. No TLS bypass was used. PDF extraction needed UTF-8 console output; a color-profile warning did not prevent text extraction.

independent_argument: Explicit prolate identities and magnetic lower bound, weighted center charts, polynomial tube-width and Laplace constants, and shrinking complex-source polydisc. The standard one-variable growth fact is explained by a polynomial vanishing on the graph and its lowest nonzero coefficient.
verification_corrections: The inherited fixed-node Hermite rule had an empty supported node set in the broad far-field Gaussian. The new check integrates the compact support directly with Gauss-Legendre panels split at taper junctions; no error tolerance was loosened.
At the exact midplane endpoint, root bracketing could fail through rounding. The new check uses the exact midplane coordinates there.
High-precision flux comparison uses identical binary inputs to distinguish numerical evaluation error from decimal-to-binary input conditioning near a center.
decision: Continue physical long-return damping and matched finite-duration band transfer. Conditional global matching for a finite resonant harmonic set now fits delta=(log q)^-2. This is not acceptance of either physical endpoint or publication novelty.
finite_q_limitation: All sampled bulk residuals remain large; integration refinement validates evaluation, not finite-q accuracy or entry into the theorem's asymptotic regime.
remaining: Loaded physical boundary and curved interface, full angular/determinant and discarded-tail response, state and renormalized stress, complete novelty review and consequential endpoint, independent verification, GCP-only Lean and manuscript.
